result.title: An Invariant Tangent-Angle Descriptor and a Band U-Net for 2D Fragment Adjacency Prediction
result.summary: This paper addresses the prediction of adjacency between pairs of 2D fragments based on their contours. We improved the two-stage architecture proposed in Beaulac's thesis, in which a rotation-equivariant Siamese convolutional neural network scores pairs of local image windows along the two contours of two fragments. The scores are gathered in an adjacency matrix in which a ResNet detects the partial anti-diagonal band that reveals the adjacency of two fragments. In the current work, we keep the pipeline and replace the local score by a comparison of tangent-angle profiles of contour windows, making it, by construction, invariant to fragment rotation and agnostic to the selected contour-starting point. These adaptations may be either a training-free likelihood ratio or a small one-dimensional convolutional model trained on corresponding points. We also replaced the final classifier by a band U-Net that segments the band and classifies the pair, so that the shared arc is obtained along with the decision. In the synthetic data set of the original thesis, the tangent descriptor performs as well as or better than the image-window approach in all tested configurations. The proposed pipeline reaches an accuracy of 98%, vs 93% to 95% for the original approach once its evaluation is corrected. We tested our pipeline, with models trained only on synthetic data, on the PairingNet benchmark, and obtained an AUC of 0.93. Furthermore, under the PairingNet pair-searching protocol conditions, our learned descriptor obtains a Recall@10 of 0.82 on the real set against 0.56 from the best model of the original paper.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向 2D 碎片轮廓配对，用对旋转和轮廓起点不变的切线角描述子替代图像窗口评分，并把最终分类器换成带状 U-Net 来同时分割反斜带与判定邻接关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不变描述子 + 矩阵中带状结构定位」思路可能为 LVR 中几何与任务必要信息如何保留在内部表示、以及候选证据如何被筛选与定位提供类比线索，但属远领域工作，需核查迁移价值。
